title: Mission Architecture Matrix Diagram
overview: This flowchart outlines the Mission Architecture Matrix and its transformation into the Mission Scale. It shows how spacecraft modules and operational steps combine through matrix operations.

stops.label: Mission Architecture Matrix (MAM)
stops.says: At the top, the Mission Architecture Matrix encapsulates spacecraft modules and basic operation steps.

stops.label: Basic Step Vector (BSV)
stops.says: The Basic Step Vector represents an individual row of operational steps.

stops.label: Basic Operation Steps (BOS)
stops.says: The Basic Operation Steps form the larger vertical collection of rows.

stops.label: Expansion
stops.says: An expansion process connects the matrix to the Basic Step Matrix.

stops.label: Spacecraft physical parameters
stops.says: Spacecraft physical parameters feed directly into the Basic Step Matrix.

stops.label: Basic Step Matrix (BSM)
stops.says: The Basic Step Matrix incorporates expansion and physical parameters.

stops.label: Matrix Operation
stops.says: A matrix operation combines the mission architecture matrix and the basic step matrix.

stops.label: Mission Scale
stops.says: At the very end, the final output yields the Mission Scale.
